multi_document.q: I am an international undergraduate in halls: what will tuition and accommodation cost me in total for a 44-week year?
multi_document.a: 21,400 GBP tuition plus 44 weeks of hall fees (128-176 GBP per week), so between 27,032 and 29,144 GBP

multi_document.q: Which two services can I contact outside normal office hours?
multi_document.a: The 24-hour study centre (library, with a student card) and campus security on extension 2222

multi_document.q: What is the difference between a self-certified extension and mitigating circumstances?
multi_document.a: A self-certified extension is up to seven days, once per year, for eligible modules; mitigating circumstances are evidence-based and go to the faculty office within five working days
